claims.evidence: Witness report only describes a washing machine in a photo; location (Abulegba) is not shown.
Witness report says the front brand label reads “NEXUS” on photo 0.

risks.risk: Brand mismatch (seller says Midea, witness sees NEXUS), which can affect parts availability and expected performance.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the brand/model plate (rating label) showing brand and model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unknown-brand used top-loader with uncertain parts support.

risks.risk: Not enough information to confirm the exact model/series and specifications (capacity, voltage, power rating).
risks.proof: A photo of the full rating plate and the control panel area showing model/series and voltage.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case spec uncertainty (assume lower capacity and unknown electrical compatibility).

risks.risk: Functionality is unverified (no proof of wash/spin, drainage, or heating if applicable).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing a full cycle start-to-spin (or at least wash + spin) with no error lights.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working or untested until demonstrated.

risks.risk: Physical condition unknown (possible dents, rust, leaks, worn hoses/rubber feet).
risks.proof: Photos of the bottom/front for leaks, hose connections, and close-ups of any rust/dents; include a quick tilt/under-side shot if safe.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing service/parts due to unknown leak/rust risk.

risks.risk: Accessories and completeness unknown (inlet/outlet hoses, drain hose, manual, warranty).
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing all included accessories (hoses, drain hose, manual/warranty if any).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the rating/model plate (brand, model/series, voltage, capacity).
Send a clear photo of the control panel area (dial/buttons) and any error lights.
Send a short video showing the machine running a wash and then spinning (or at least spin) with no errors.
Send photos of hoses and connections, plus a bottom/under-side shot to check for leaks/rust.
Confirm and photograph included accessories (inlet hose, drain hose, manual/warranty if any).
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a NEXUS washing machine, but key details that determine a safe Lagos used price—exact model/specs and whether it works (wash/spin) and is leak-free—are not shown. Also, the seller’s brand claim conflicts with the witness observation, increasing uncertainty until verified with the rating plate and a running test.
